title: Each of his senses was brought under a rigorous discipline.
html_source: Stephen’s strict discipline towards religion forces him to bring his senses under rigorous discipline in order to avoid the temptation to sin. Stephen’s senses appear extremely important throughout Part 4

anchor.text: Each of his senses was brought under a rigorous discipline.
anchor.prefix: imself to desist from even the least or lowliest devotion, striving also by constant mortification to undo the sinful past rather than to achieve a saintliness fraught with peril.
anchor.suffix: In order to mortify the sense of sight he made it his rule to walk in the street with downcast eyes, glancing neither to right nor left and never behind him. His eyes shunned ever
anchor.canonical_text: Each of his senses was brought under a rigorous discipline.
